rows.label: tlk43200141_03_msg0001
rows.name: Ion-chan seems a little better now.

rows.label: tlk43200141_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I heard someone important to her died,
and she blamed herself. It sounds like
she was suffering over it.

rows.label: tlk43200141_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I've never experienced grief that
deep, so I can't really understand
what she's going through...

rows.label: tlk43200141_03_msg0004
rows.name:
But I want to help Ion-chan find some
peace of mind.

rows.label: tlk43200141_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Maybe by eating Fleur Bavarois
together.
